svg.title: Memory: legal deep harness
svg.desc: Six historical snapshots are parallel layers along a time axis. Viewed from the front they align, and the latest snapshot hides the others. The camera moves around to the side of the layers to reveal the complete history: documents are created, matter context accumulates, and earlier work is revised. The camera then returns to the front. The camera reveals time as depth, with older snapshots receding into the distance.
